text: Walter Dean Myers's Monster was challenged in 2019 at Gates Middle School (Scituate, MA) for “language, violence, and sexual overtures” and deemed inappropriate for 8th and 9th-graders. After meeting with parents, school administrators removed it from the curriculum, and the ban remained in effect despite protest at a public meeting. In a second case, after parental complaints about the maturity of language and sexual content in 7th grade reading club selections, a teacher at Signal Mountain (TN) Middle-High School told parents she was removing Monster from the reading list; the principal later said the books were high school reading materials, not 7th grade.
meta_description: Monster by Walter Dean Myers: challenged in 2019 at Gates Middle School, removed from the curriculum, and dropped from a Signal Mountain reading list.
